steps.name: Frost
steps.text: Find anything?

steps.name: Ash
steps.text: Got something! It's not much, but it's something.

steps.name: Rangers
steps.text: Good work. These provisions, along with the emergency store in the safehouse, should keep us fed for a week, if we stretch it.

steps.name: Ash
steps.text: It's getting late. Let's head back.

steps.name: Schwarz
steps.text: ...Someone's coming.

steps.name: Rangers
steps.text: How many?

steps.name: Schwarz
steps.text: ...A dozen maybe. Could be mercenaries.

steps.name: Rangers
steps.text: Hurry! Back to the safehouse!

steps.name: Rangers
steps.text: Are they still on us?

steps.name: Schwarz
steps.text: ...Yes.

steps.name: Rangers
steps.text: That's not good.

steps.name: Ash
steps.text: I knew they wouldn't let up.

steps.name: Rangers
steps.text: We are bound to get sieged if we choose to fight here. Keep retreating.

steps.name: Tachanka
steps.text: What happened?

steps.name: Ash
steps.text: We've got company. Get ready to fight.

steps.name: Schwarz
steps.text: Something's not right...

steps.name: Schwarz
steps.text: ...Hold your fire...

steps.name: Tachanka
steps.text: Why?

steps.name: Schwarz
steps.text: ...It's not those mercenaries.

steps.name: Schwarz
steps.text: ...They're Reproba soldiers...

steps.name: Rangers
steps.text: Local guards?

steps.name: Rangers
steps.text: Hold fire!

steps.name: Picale
steps.text: Guards, surround the structure! Don't let anyone escape.

steps.name: Blitz
steps.text: Wait a second, are we surrounded?

steps.name: Rangers
steps.text: ...This isn't good.

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: Why are the Lord's men encircling us?

steps.name: Rangers
steps.text: Let's have you quiet down for now.

steps.name: Picale
steps.text: I want all of you inside to listen up!

steps.name: Picale
steps.text: I am the captain of the Long Spring village guard, daughter of the Lord of Long Spring, Picale Tulla.

steps.name: Picale
steps.text: I want you all to lay down your weapons and come out nice and easy.

steps.name: Picale
steps.text: Don't test my patience. You'll regret it.

a.text: The imposing Reproba warrior strikes the halberd into the ground with all her might.
And the earth starts to tremble instantly.

steps.name: Picale
steps.text: Mercenaries. It's always mercenaries.

steps.name: Picale
steps.text: You shameless, faithless, virtueless bastards. How much gold did my evil brother give you?

steps.name: Picale
steps.text: You won't get away. I'll crush you. I'll stomp you into dust.

steps.name: Picale
steps.text: I'll make you pay for everything you've done.

steps.name: Picale
steps.text: Once I cut you down, you'll finally understand that no amount of blood money can buy you another life!

steps.name: Blitz
steps.text: Oh! Oh! Are you sure they're here to help?

steps.name: Blitz
steps.text: I think they'd rather hang us from the town gate.

steps.name: Ash
steps.text: That's what I'm afraid of.

steps.name: Rangers
steps.text: There's definitely a misunderstanding here.

steps.name: Rangers
steps.text: Lady Picale.

steps.name: Rangers
steps.text: I'm a field operator with Rhodes Island, code name Rangers.

steps.name: Rangers
steps.text: I'm pretty sure Rhodes Island signed a cooperation agreement with your family.

steps.name: Rangers
steps.text: We're...

steps.name: Picale
steps.text: Shut up!

steps.name: Picale
steps.text: Rhodes Island! Sanctimonious hypocrites!

steps.name: Picale
steps.text: My father trusted you! He believed your promises. That's why he agreed to your safehouse.

steps.name: Picale
steps.text: And how did you repay him?

steps.name: Picale
steps.text: You kidnapped our people! Robbed them of everything they had! I saw it!

steps.name: Picale
steps.text: You're a bunch of treacherous villains!

steps.name: Ash
steps.text: If you think for a single second, you'll know that doesn't make any sense.

steps.name: Ash
steps.text: If we wanted to pillage the town, why would we still be here?

steps.name: Picale
steps.text: Don't try to talk your way out of this!

steps.name: Picale
steps.text: And who the hell are you?

steps.name: Picale
steps.text: You're standing on my father's land with your guns, and you dare to argue with me?!

steps.name: Ash
steps.text: If you're so tough, where have you been all this time?

steps.name: Ash
steps.text: You and the Lord's men let those thugs raid the quarantine zone so we had to risk our lives to save the townsfolk in there. What were your precious guardsmen doing then?

steps.name: Ash
steps.text: And you still think you can come here and talk a big game with us?

steps.name: Tachanka
steps.text: Settle down. She doesn't seem like the type you can reason with.

steps.name: Miarow
steps.text: Lady Picale!

steps.name: Miarow
steps.text: I'm Dr. Miarow, from the Infected quarter! We've met before!

steps.name: Picale
steps.text: ...Right. I know you.

steps.name: Miarow
steps.text: Rhodes Island didn't rob the Infected. I can testify to that! We were forced here by the riots.

steps.name: Miarow
steps.text: And it's not just me. Any of the Infected here will tell you that.

steps.name: Miarow
steps.text: Lady Picale, I need you to trust me.

steps.name: Picale
steps.text: ...I trust you, Doctor. Many people speak highly of you.

steps.name: Miarow
steps.text: Thank you, Lady Picale.

steps.name: Picale
steps.text: But I don't trust them!

a.text: The imposing daughter of the Lord points forward with her colossal halberd.

steps.name: Picale
steps.text: It is a grave infraction to enter my father's territory, armed, without permission!

steps.name: Picale
steps.text: In light of you protecting my father's subjects...

steps.name: Picale
steps.text: I will pardon you for that infraction.

steps.name: Picale
steps.text: As for Rhodes Island! The contract you signed with my father is, as of today, null and void.

steps.name: Rangers
steps.text: ...Please reconsider.

steps.name: Picale
steps.text: There is nothing to discuss!

steps.name: Picale
steps.text: Long Spring does not need armed foreigners, not even Rhodes Islanders!

steps.name: Picale
steps.text: I will gather up the Infected and take them where they belong.

steps.name: Picale
steps.text: We don't need you getting involved.

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: But...

steps.name: Rangers
steps.text: Alright. Don't speak.

steps.name: Rangers
steps.text: Do not defy the local Lord. We are standing here at Sargon as Rhodes Island operators.

steps.name: Lord's Guard
steps.text: Forty-one, forty-two...

steps.name: Lord's Guard
steps.text: Any others?

steps.name: Miarow
steps.text: That's all...

steps.name: Lord's Guard
steps.text: No problem. We'll get you to safety.

steps.name: Miarow
steps.text: Miss Cohen, Mr. Alexsandr.

steps.name: Miarow
steps.text: Thank you for all that you've done.

steps.name: Ash
steps.text: No need. We should be thanking you.

steps.name: Miarow
steps.text: Where are you going to go?

steps.name: Ash
steps.text: Not sure yet.

steps.name: Tachanka
steps.text: Let's not make it sound so sad.

steps.name: Tachanka
steps.text: Maybe we'll meet again someday.

steps.name: Tachanka
steps.text: I'll have to tell you about it next time...

steps.name: Tachanka
steps.text: *Cough* *cough*... the story of the dog-headed man.

steps.name: Miarow
steps.text: Hahaha... alright.

steps.name: Rangers
steps.text: Doctor, this is for you.

steps.name: Miarow
steps.text: It's... an Originium Ingot. But I can't...

steps.name: Rangers
steps.text: Remuneration. For Occphen's leg.

steps.name: Miarow
steps.text: That was just some basic first aid... it's not worth this much...

steps.name: Rangers
steps.text: I think it's worth it. Take it.

steps.name: Miarow
steps.text: Thanks, Mr. Rangers.

steps.name: Miarow
steps.text: And... thank you all.

steps.name: Miarow
steps.text: Goodbye.

steps.name: Schwarz
steps.text: Something's off.

steps.name: Rangers
steps.text: I know.

steps.name: Rangers
steps.text: *Sigh*. I thought caution was the right move, but we ended up with a big misunderstanding.

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: Who would've thought the captain of the guard would be so difficult?

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: A muscle-headed moron. We have enough of those at BSW.

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: So what do we do?

steps.name: Occphen
steps.text: They seized pretty much everything from the safehouse.

steps.name: Rangers
steps.text: At least we're all unharmed. That's what really matters.

steps.name: Rangers
steps.text: Come with us, Mr. Occphen. We'll sign you in at the branch office, then contact the landship and figure out what to do.

steps.name: Occphen
steps.text: That's really our only option.

steps.name: Schwarz
steps.text: ...I'm not so sure.

steps.name: Rangers
steps.text: What do you mean?

steps.name: Schwarz
steps.text: ...That Picale woman... could she be the one behind all this?

steps.name: Schwarz
steps.text: The Lord was so slow to act, even as the mercenaries were rounding up the Infected.

steps.name: Schwarz
steps.text: ...And now we've got a captain of the guard, taking everyone away all nice and legally.

steps.name: Schwarz
steps.text: This can't just be a coincidence.

steps.name: Rangers
steps.text: ...That does make sense.

steps.name: Schwarz
steps.text: ...I'm going to tail them... and see.

steps.name: Ash
steps.text: I'm going too.

steps.name: Rangers
steps.text: No. More hands are more easily seen.

steps.name: Rangers
steps.text: The rest of you stand by.

steps.name: Rangers
steps.text: What's the matter?

steps.name: Schwarz
steps.text: I thought you won't agree with this plan.

steps.name: Rangers
steps.text: Avoiding conflicts with the local Lord doesn't mean our hands are tied here. We need to play to the score.

steps.name: Rangers
steps.text: Some times you need a few tricks to get things working.

steps.name: Schwarz
steps.text: I see...

steps.name: Picale
steps.text: Get them all to shelter first, then I want three with me.

steps.name: Picale
steps.text: I think there's something happening in the mines.

steps.name: Lord's Guard
steps.text: Understood.

steps.name: Picale
steps.text: Is there enough room left in the shelter?

steps.name: Lord's Guard
steps.text: Not really. Half of the town's population is already inside.

steps.name: Picale
steps.text: Tell them to move upstairs if necessary. Them can have my father's room.

steps.name: Lord's Guard
steps.text: Is this...really necessary?

steps.name: Picale
steps.text: I don't see anything wrong with it. My father will do the same should he lived.

steps.name: Lord's Guard
steps.text: ...I see.

steps.name: Picale
steps.text: Don't let your guard down anyway.

steps.name: Picale
steps.text: ...Wait, did the lights go out as soon as we left?

steps.name: Lord's Guard
steps.text: I don't remember...

steps.name: Picale
steps.text: Out of the way！

steps.name: Lord's Guard
steps.text: Aaah!

steps.name: Originiutant
steps.text: Gaa...

steps.name: Picale
steps.text: We're under attack! Protect the civilians!

steps.name: Picale
steps.text: Where did they come from?!

steps.name: Picale
steps.text: What are you waiting for?! Get ready to break through!

steps.name: Lord's Guard
steps.text: There's too many of them!

steps.name: Picale
steps.text: Take the civilians and get out of here! I'm breaking off!

steps.name: Picale
steps.text: Come on, you cowardly bandits!

steps.name: Picale
steps.text: Phew... How many was that?

steps.name: Picale
steps.text: Finally.

steps.name: Miarow
steps.text: Lady Picale!

steps.name: Picale
steps.text: Doctor! What are y ou doing here?!

steps.name: Miarow
steps.text: Don't go! The Lord's Manor has already been...

steps.name: Picale
steps.text: Doctor!

steps.name: Picale
steps.text: Drudge!

steps.name: Picale
steps.text: Get the hell out of here! I'm going to chop your goddamned head off!

steps.name: Drudge
steps.text: Hahaha... You're loud as you ever were, dear sister.

steps.name: Picale
steps.text: You... You disgusting... I have to kill you.

steps.name: Drudge
steps.text: Show me what you've got.

a.text: As the imposing Reproba charges at her brother with shocking speed, she realizes it.
She's fallen right into a trap.
Under the cover of night, behind the crumbling houses, a machine rumbles.
In one second, she feels herself struck dizzy by a ferocious blow, as if slammed right in the face by a boulder launched from a catapult.
In the next second, she falls unconscious.
